definitions: To display or show off one's accomplishments or successes in a boastful or ostentatious way.
To draw attention to one's successes, often in a way that seeks admiration or recognition.
examples: He tends to parade his achievements at every company meeting.
She was advised not to parade her achievements too much, as it could alienate colleagues.
After winning the award, he couldn't resist parading his achievements to everyone he met.
